subject: Runway bridging proposal: phased rebaseline & escalation ladder
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@heliohealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@heliohealth.com>, Legal Ops <legal@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MAP + timeline questions after demo

Priyom —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. The team loved the latency profiles and the ability to pin model versions, but we looked at our internal project calendar and we are seeing pressure that will likely push our acceptance window out.

Quick summary of Helio's constraints:
- Procurement sign-off scheduled for 6/10 but finance needs final unit-cost numbers; any extra weeks on the acceptance window increases budget risk.
- Security team needs SOC 2 snippets and an audit log sample before final acceptance.
- We have an internal go/no-go on 6/21. If we miss that, our pilot moves to Q3.

I've attached our current MAP (MAP_v1) and a snapshot of our acceptance criteria. We want to avoid a full rebaseline if possible — can Redwood propose a short-run bridging plan (2-week phased shift) that keeps the critical path intact and shows mitigation lanes? If you can provide a risk log and an escalation ladder we can present to finance/legal this week, that would help.

Next steps we propose:
1) Redwood sends a brief rebaseline proposal + risk log by EOD 5/29.
2) Weekly checkpoints (Wed) between Redwood PM and our PM starting 6/2.
3) Legal receives required audit artifacts by 6/4.

Can you confirm whether a two-week phased shift is feasible and what concessions (credits, migration assistance, additional trials) Redwood could offer to keep us green for the 6/21 window?

—Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Senior PM, Helio Health
Alyssa Chen | Helio Health
Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: Acceptance-Criteria.pdf

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@heliohealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + timeline questions after demo

Alyssa —

Appreciate the clear summary and the attachments. Short answer: yes, a phased two-week shift is feasible and we can surface committed mitigation lanes that limit downstream exposure. Below is a compact rebaseline + risk log for your packet to finance/legal.

Executive summary (for your leadership):
- Proposed rebaseline: move final acceptance target from 2027-06-14 to 2027-06-28 (two-week shift).
- Why this works: preserves the pilot cutover (feature parity) while giving security time for artifact review and procurement time to finalize cost terms.
- Mitigation lanes we will run in parallel: prefix/KV cache tuning pass (reduces token cost variance), accelerated canary rollout to keep latency SLO intact, and a dedicated SE pairing to accelerate integration testing.

Risk log (short):
1) Procurement delay — Likelihood: medium; Impact: high. Mitigation: provide token-level cost breakdown and commit to a one-time migration credit (see concessions).
2) Security artifact lag — Likelihood: medium; Impact: medium. Mitigation: deliver SOC-2 excerpt + audit-log sample by 6/3; SE-led evidence session with your security on 6/4.
3) Integration test failures — Likelihood: low; Impact: high. Mitigation: 48-hour hotfix SLA for pilot-critical regressions; SE triage on-call.

Concessions we can offer to keep the 6/21 internal go/no-go green:
- One-time onboarding credit equal to 2 weeks of committed Dedicated capacity (applied to first invoice)
- Free SE pairing for the first two cutover sprints

Operational asks from Helio to make this work:
- Legal: confirm outstanding evidence list by EOD 5/31 so we prioritize deliverables.
- Procurement: final cost acceptance or focused list of clarifications by 6/7.

We're including a small phased rollout plan in the attached MAP_v2 (xslx) that lists responsibilities and checkpoint owners. If this looks acceptable, I'll convert the MAP to a mutual action plan document your procurement team can sign-off on and we'll schedule the first SE pairing.

On the escalation ladder: we propose the following routing if we hit a blocker — Tier 1: SE + PM (daily), Tier 2: Sales AM + Solutions Lead (within 24 hours), Tier 3: Head of Sales (Rishi) + Exec sponsor (within 48 hours). I'll send a single-page escalation ladder as an appendix.

I'll follow up with attachments and a short version for finance/legal.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: 2027-05-29-MAP-v2.xlsx, Runway-Risk-Log.csv

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@heliohealth.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Runway bridging proposal: phased rebaseline & escalation ladder

Quick note from Rishi —

Thanks for the fast turnaround, Priyom. Two tactical asks from my side to reduce the chance of rebaseline creep:
1) Offer a one-time acceptance credit (we proposed onboarding credit already) — let's make it explicit in the MAP_v2 summary line so finance has a single-row concession to record.
2) Request that Legal (Helio) prioritizes the audit-log sample review on 6/3 and sends any redlines to our legal@redwood.com alias same day. If we don't hear back by EOD 6/4, we will trigger an escalation to Head of Legal for triage.

Additionally, I'm authorizing SE pairing for two sprints; Priya, can you coordinate availability?

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@heliohealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@heliohealth.com>, Legal Ops <legal@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runway bridging proposal: phased rebaseline & escalation ladder

Priyom / Rishi / Priya —

Thank you for the detailed proposal and the concessions. We reviewed MAP_v2 with finance this afternoon and are prepared to accept the two-week phased rebaseline under the following conditions:
- Helio will accept final acceptance target of 2027-06-28 provided Redwood delivers the SOC-2 excerpt + audit-log sample by 2027-06-03 and Security pairing session on 2027-06-04.
- Procurement will issue a PO (attached: PO_Helio_4621.pdf) contingent on final cost table and the one-time onboarding credit being documented in the MAP summary.
- We require a single-line summary of the escalation ladder and a one-page risk register for leadership — can you send those by EOD 6/2 so we can attach to the PO?

Priya — please be our Redwood lead for the evaluation plan and coordinate the SE pairing days with Tom. We'll expect the first Wednesday checkpoint on 2027-06-02 at 10:00 PT.

A quick note for your legal team: we may request a minor addendum to the data retention language; Legal Ops will circulate specifics by 6/3.

Looking forward to the checkpoint on 6/2.

—Alyssa
Attachment: PO_Helio_4621.pdf (purchase order stub)
